$comment: Wafar Asraa receipt extraction v1. Sent to the Claude Messages API as output_config.format = {type: 'json_schema', schema: <this file without $comment>}. Every object has additionalProperties:false and every field is required; unknown values are null, never guessed. Money is a JSON number in the receipt currency (EGP) with up to 2 decimals. Numbers always use Western digits (0-9) even when the receipt prints Arabic-Indic digits.

is_receipt.description: true if the input is a shopping receipt or a clear description of a purchase. false for anything else (selfie, menu, screenshot of a chat, blank photo).

language.description: Main language printed on the receipt or spoken in the note.

name_raw.description: Store name exactly as printed or said, in its original script. Empty string if not shown.

name_en.description: Store name in English or Latin letters if known, else null.

branch_raw.description: Branch name as printed, e.g. 'فرع التجمع'. null if not shown.

address_raw.description: Address as printed. null if not shown.

purchase_date.description: Date on the receipt as YYYY-MM-DD. Egyptian receipts usually print DD/MM/YYYY. null if not printed or not readable.

purchase_time.description: Time on the receipt as 24h HH:MM. null if not printed.

currency.description: EGP unless the receipt clearly shows another currency.

items.description: One entry per printed line item, in printed order. Do not merge or split lines. Empty array if no items are readable.

raw_name.description: Item name exactly as printed, including abbreviations, in its original script.

name_en.description: Short plain English name, e.g. 'Sunflower oil'. null if the item cannot be identified.

brand.description: Brand if identifiable from the line, e.g. 'Crystal'. null otherwise.

size_text.description: Size or weight as printed, e.g. '1ل', '500g', '2.5 kg'. null if not shown.

barcode.description: Barcode digits if printed on the line. null otherwise.

quantity.description: Units or weight bought. 1 if not shown. Weighed items use the printed weight in kg.

unit_price.description: Price per unit or per kg if printed. null if only the line total is printed.

line_total.description: Amount charged for this line before any separate discount line.

discount.description: Discount applied to this specific line, as a positive number. 0 if none.

category.description: Best-fit category. Matches categories.slug in the database.

subtotal.description: Subtotal as printed. null if not printed.

discount_total.description: Total discount on the whole receipt as a positive number. 0 if none.

tax_total.description: VAT or service charge as printed. null if not printed.

total.description: Final amount paid as printed. null only if it truly cannot be read.

payment_method.description: How the customer paid, if printed.

confidence.description: Your overall confidence from 0 to 1 that store, date, items and total are all read correctly.

issues.description: Problems that should make the bot ask the user for a clearer photo or a correction. Empty array if none.
